title: %convertUnit - unit conversion
purpose: Convert a value between two compatible units of the same family.
notes: Supports mass, length, volume, speed, area, data, time, and temperature (C/F/K) families.
Results are rounded to at most six decimal places.
Incompatible units across families (e.g. kg -> km) yield null (~).

avoid.why: the units belong to different families (mass vs length), so the conversion yields null (~)
